predict.question: Your trading rule gains 1 point on 99% of days and loses 200 on the other 1%. On average, what does it net per day?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Rare events can dominate conclusions built on ordinary observations.
modelBoundary: Omitting the tail gives {A}; including it gives {B}. Its 1% probability stays fixed, but its weighted loss outweighs the common gain.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This mean follows arithmetic. It does not estimate unseen-event probabilities or verify a forecast.
